_comment: I2 'THE HAT STAYS ON', THE TALK ROUTE (v0.16 #306). Takes Wilovan's errand at the parlor, runs the three exchanges with the Adventurer's Rest house factor for handoff_talked, and reports back for hat_job_done + 25 gold. The hub's visible-row arithmetic is the fragile part and is stated at each pick: with the Brothers' job done and no cups_debt_chit in the pack, the Cups row renders VISIBLE-LOCKED and holds index 1, so the new rows sit at index 3. Seed inert: nothing fights.

steps._comment: Title's default row is New Game -- down 1 to Continue, which loads the fixture-seeded manual slot.
Every {addr} pin below resolves to 'sir' for this fixture's default identity -- assert the identity so a future change fails HERE and not at a text pin.

payload_contains.speaker: Wilovan
payload_contains.text: Evening. Might I say, sir, you carry yourself like a person things happen to. We collect a few of those.

payload_contains.speaker: Wilovan
payload_contains.text: Sir. The parlor door is never shut to you, the alleys are safe as churches. Safer, if anything — we keep better hours. And a man remembers. All of us remember.

steps._comment: Four visible rows with the Brothers' job done: 'Evening.', the Cups chit row (item-gated, VISIBLE-LOCKED -- this save holds no cups_debt_chit), the marker row, and the errand row LAST. Down 3.

payload_contains.speaker: Wilovan
payload_contains.text: There is, sir, and I'll ask your pardon before I describe it, because describing it is most of the offence. A small parcel wants to be somewhere else by morning, and the somewhere else drinks at the Adventurer's Rest. House rule there is that nobody raises a voice. We hold to it. So does everybody who owes them a table.

steps._comment: Row 0 takes the errand; rows 1 and 2 are the what-if and the decline.

payload_contains.speaker: Wilovan
payload_contains.text: Then here are the manners of it. You don't name the thing, you don't name the man, and you don't hurry. A gentleman who hurries is a gentleman explaining himself later. Hat stays on the whole while, sir. That's not superstition. That's the whole of the etiquette.

steps._comment: == THE REST, THE TALK ROUTE. The factor stands at (6,1); approach from (6,2) and bump north. First interact is his pool line, the second opens the graph. ==

payload_contains.speaker: The House Factor
payload_contains.text: Long table's for people waiting on somebody. This one's for people who've already arrived.

payload_contains.speaker: The House Factor
payload_contains.text: You'll want the long table, sir, not this one. Long table's for people waiting on somebody. This one's for people who have already arrived.

steps._comment: Three visible rows: the wait arm (armed by hat_job_taken), 'Busy house.', and the leave row.

payload_contains.speaker: The House Factor
payload_contains.text: Then you're early or you're late. Somebody in this room has already counted. I haven't heard which.

payload_contains.speaker: The House Factor
payload_contains.text: Warm is a good answer. The gentleman who left that coat was warm too. No word yet on when he'll be back for it. The coat's paid for through the season.

payload_contains.speaker: The House Factor
payload_contains.text: Mind it well, sir. Nobody in this room raises their voice and nobody in this room has ever seen a thing. That isn't a rule of the house. That's the rent.

steps._comment: == THE REPORT. Wilovan's pool is spent for this waking, so the interact opens the hub directly; the errand row is now hidden and the report row has taken its place. ==
Still four visible rows, the last one swapped: the errand row hides on hat_job_taken and the report row arms on it.

payload_contains.speaker: Wilovan
payload_contains.text: It is, and I've had it confirmed by a man who does not confirm things. Tell me how the room took it, sir, and I'll know what I owe you.
